authority: Structured numerical authority for action phases, reactions, weapon timing, interruption and contact time.
reaction_rules: recognition uses awareness plus information and visibility
prepared reactions reserve attention and timing
substitution requires a real prepared decoy and legal path
Body Flicker is movement, not teleportation
sustained techniques reserve chakra and multitasking nodes

weapon_timing.requirement: Every combat weapon must resolve a maneuver_package_id. Every maneuver has base startup, contact window, geometry, grip, reach rule, recovery and interruption conditions.
weapon_timing.timing_score: weapon_skill + coordination_support + floor(agility_support/2) + equipment_support - fatigue - injury - external_load - disruption
weapon_timing.minimum_rule: No mastery reduces a physical phase to zero; recovery and occupied limbs remain real.
